CODE: RAGDOLL
• 11-20-2026

🎯 2X TASK REWARDS THIS WEEKEND! Daily tasks pay double until Sunday.

Ragdoll physics sandbox: test dummies react to everything you do. 💥

🎯 NEW: DAILY TASKS — 3 a day + a bonus. REWARDS > TASKS.
🆓 NEW: FREE TRIALS — try Giant Hands, Laser Eyes and Tentacle Control for 60 s.
🖐️ NEW: GIANT HANDS — pinch, squish and flick dummies. Press 7.
👋 NEW: INVITE FRIENDS — 1,000 coins per new friend.
🌐 MULTIPLAYER — 8 players, same dummies for everyone.
🔫 ARMED DUMMIES — aim at them and they aim back.
🏙️ THE TOWN — a second map. Press MAPS.
🤝 Hold B near a dummy: high five, hug, dance, joke.
🐙 TENTACLES — grab, slam, squish, throw.
🔨 WEAPONS — bats, katana, chainsaw, guns. U to inspect.
🏭 MACHINES — crusher, cannon, rocket and more.
🧰 SANDBOX — slow time, change gravity, freeze the world.

🎁 FREE tentacles: join the group and favourite the game.
⚙️ Lagging? Settings > DETAIL > LOW.

New updates every week. Like and favourite!
